senses.gloss: lipi, f. (Skt.), writing; in LV 〔125.19 ff.〕 the Bodhisattva lists 64 kinds of script; in Mv 〔i.135.5 ff.〕 a similar but much shorter list; Senartʼs note compares the two. Non-Skt. items from either list are included here.
lipika (from lipi), writer, clerk, scribe: Divy 〔293.5, 9〕.
līpyase, thou art stained: Gv 〔389.2〕, prob. misprint for lipyase.
